Lines.Text: This was the last chance I had bought by selling everything I owned.
We can just cover the mold. Let's start over from here.
Hehe, even cup noodles taste amazing when we all eat together! Buy us beef when we debut!
Ah, right. V.E.L.O.? Um... just leave it on the desk. I'll give it a listen.
Even their thin courtesy was more than we were allowed.
The interest on time borrowed against a dream was crueler than I could have imagined.
The coldest, darkest night. Can I... really protect these girls?
